definition: a paved yard behind a house
description: In the paved yard behind a low house at sunset, a young man in a green rugby shirt grills a long coiled sausage on a round charcoal kettle. Flames leap up over a row of meat skewers, he lifts a browned piece with tongs and turns to the camera laughing while friends stand around the yard with drinks.
